# Endless Testing

> A/B testing for AI generalists. Run A/B tests on a landing page from Claude, Codex, or ChatGPT through the CLI, MCP, or API.

The winner stays live. The next round starts itself. CLI, MCP, and API are equal. Pricing is $299/mo, or $249/mo billed annually. 7-day free trial, card required.

Full detail: https://endlesstesting.ai/llms-full.txt

## Product

- [Landing page](https://endlesstesting.ai/): product, pricing, and how a round works.
- [Dashboard](https://dash.endlesstesting.ai/): sign in, results, and the kill switch. Start the 7-day trial here.
- [Docs](https://docs.endlesstesting.ai): documentation.
- [API](https://api.endlesstesting.ai): HTTP API. The page SDK is https://api.endlesstesting.ai/api/sdk.js
- [GitHub](https://github.com/valentinyeo/endless-testing): source.

## CLI

The binary is `et`. Output is JSON. `ET_API` sets the API base (default https://api.endlesstesting.ai). `ET_TOKEN` overrides `~/.config/endlesstesting/token`.

```
et login --email <email>
et login --code <code>
et logout
et whoami
et sites
et site add <url>
et snippet <site>
et check <site>
et goals <site>
et goal set <site> --text <button>
et brand <site>
et brand set <site> --field <k=v>
et brand autofill <site>
et round start <site> [--url <page>]
et status <site>
et results <site>
et feed <site>
et pause <test>
et resume <test>
et reject <variant>
et kill <site> on|off
et mcp
et help
```

`et login --email you@example.com` sends the same email code as the dashboard. `et login --code <code>` stores the account token. Add `--text` to print indented JSON. On `et goal set`, `--text` is the button label instead.

## MCP

`et mcp` is an MCP server on stdio. Tools match the CLI.

Claude Code:

```
claude mcp add endlesstesting -- et mcp
```

Codex, in `~/.codex/config.toml`:

```
[mcp_servers.endlesstesting]
command = "et"
args = ["mcp"]
```

ChatGPT and any other MCP client use the same stdio server: command `et`, args `mcp`.
